simple.meaning: נֶפֶל (nephel) is a Hebrew word meaning “something fallen , i.e. an abortion.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: נֶפֶל (H5309) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Job 3:16, with occurrences in Job, Psalms, Ecclesiastes.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to נֶפֶל (H5309) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in נֶפֶל (H5309) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: נֶפֶל (nephel) / H5309 is traced through Job 3:16, Psalms 58:9, Ecclesiastes 6:3 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
